scope: Metadata review against complete parsed SVG titles, descriptions when present, visible text, and existing computed checks. No lessons or image sources modified.
maintenance: This audit is the maintained alt/caption backup. After a generator rewrites placements, reapply entries by the exact (lesson, file, editable) triple only after confirming SVG hashes still match. Lesson integration is deferred to the parent after authoring freezes.
notes: SVG titles repeat generic authoring briefs; no SVG desc elements are present. Concrete metadata comes from actual visible SVG labels and computed checks.
The computed remove edge check uses an isolated three-vertex fixture; the diagram and named remove-edge check preserve A-C. Metadata follows the diagram, not the different fixture.
